SECTION_TITLE: CoreZoneDisplay Settings (Toggle Any Setting to Open / Close)
OPEN_SETTING_DOC: Toggle ON to open and edit this setting group; toggle OFF to close it up.
SETTING_5_HEADER: Setting 5: Web Display & Clock Settings URLs (...)
DISPLAY_MODE_DOC: Choose whether to run purely as a standalone Clock Screensaver or show the Full Player Menu with idle screensaver.
ENABLE_SCREENSAVER_DOC: Automatically display the clock screensaver overlay when the screen is idle in Full Menu mode.
IDLE_TIMEOUT_DOC: Seconds of inactivity before the clock screensaver overlay activates in Full Menu mode.
ACTIVE_CLOCK_DOC: Choose which clock HTML file from submodule/clocks to display.
DISPLAY_URL_DOC: Open this URL in any browser or kiosk display to control CoreZoneDisplay.
CLOCK_SETTINGS_URL_DOC: Open this URL to customize the Digital Clock layout, Hebrew date, and colors.
PREVENT_SCREENSAVER_PLAYING_DOC: Keep Now Playing album art and controls active while audio plays. The screensaver clock will only start after playback is paused or stopped.
